_comment: Routine action kind `agent` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3). Runs a saved agent definition headlessly in the app. Unlike today's scheduled agents, the input is carried through and the products it makes are registered and linked to the run.
summary: Run one of your agents on a schedule.
help: Runs a saved agent inside mChatAI+ with the input you give it. Whatever it makes shows up under the routine's run history and in the owning conversation's Products.

input.title: Input
input.description: What the agent is asked to do on each run. Optional.
